title: Get Shelf settings
description: Get Shelf settings. Secrets are never returned.

host.description: Host name for the application, like 'shelf.domain.org'. Empty if not configured yet.

lets_encrypt.title: Let's Encrypt certificate
lets_encrypt.description: A valid Let's Encrypt certificate is requested.

maptiler_token_set.title: A MapTiler API key is configured
maptiler_token_set.description: The key itself is never returned.

smarthost_enabled.title: The cluster smarthost is enabled
smarthost_enabled.description: Shelf sends the sign-in codes through it. Without it nobody can sign in.
